# hwlog

hwlog is an append-only hardware prototype log.
Extension: .hwlog
Banner: # hwlog v1
Frontmatter must include PROJECT.
Body is ENTRY blocks with KEY: value lines.
Allowed keys: STATUS PROGRESS PART BOM SOURCE BLOCKER NEXT NOTE RIG SEQ
STATUS enum: Concept Design Prototyping Testing Production Ready Complete On Hold
PROGRESS is 0-100.
Append only. Never rewrite a prior ENTRY.
Declared format only. Not an OS MIME type.
Declaration: assets/hwlog.kind
Sample: examples/sample.hwlog
Machine pack: ai-discovery/pack.json
